response.overview: Indulge yourself in the ultimate celebration of mutual harmony of body and soul with Playboy: Complete Massage, a provocative hands-on approach to intimacy and eccstasy. The language of sensual touch is put into laymen's terms to show-and-tell you the strokes and therapies of the masters.  Playboy: Complete Massage will seduce you with six erotic massage sequences that explore the give-and-take benefits of Swedish and Oriental techniques. Featured sequences include a romantic wake-up massage with a French facial, a sexy stretching massage by the warmth of the foreplace, a passionate midnight massage for lovers, and a sensuous soak in the soothing waters of a Japanese bath.  Put the pleasure into action as Playboy: Complete Massage takes you on an unforgettable journey into the sensual world of relaxation and stimulation. Reach out and touch someone you love. Was also released as a Phillips  interactive CD-i.
response.title: Playboy's Complete Massage
